title: StarsAndPixels' Custom Items
description: This is a resource pack that adds custom item renames that focus on media that i like! (Works in vanilla!)
body:
This is a resource pack that adds custom models for items that you can apply by renaming them in an anvil to make them look like items from media that i like!

This resource pack has both custom 3D models that are seen in the player's hand, and also 2D icons for when they're seen in the inventory or dropped in the ground. Some items also have unique features! For example, the Master Sword will go in it's scabbard when put in the offhand, and the wands will have a glowing animation when they're being charged up.

## Currently contains:
* "Master Sword" _(Netherite Sword)_
* "Fairy Ocarina" _(Goat Horn)_
* "Ocarina of Time" _(Goat Horn)_
* "Fairy" _(Totem of Undying)_
* "Zora Sapphire" _(Totem of Undying)_
* "StarsAndPixels' Wand" _(Bow)_
* "Star's Wand (S1)" _(Bow)_
* "Star's Wand (S2)" _(Bow)_
* "Star's Wand (S3)" _(Bow)_
* "Niko's Hat" _(Carved Pumpkin)_
* "Pomni's Hat" _(Carved Pumpkin)_

I also recommend the [RPRenames](https://modrinth.com/mod/rp-renames) mod to see what is added! It's a mod that i quite like and is very helpful with these packs.
# By StarsAndPixels :3
